# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected security or privacy vulnerabilities privately to **support@gurjas.org**. Do not open a public issue containing exploit details, personal data, credentials, unpublished research material, or information that could identify a client, participant, institution, or reviewer.

Include the affected URL or file, a concise reproduction path, the observed impact, and any safe supporting evidence. Please avoid destructive testing, automated traffic that could disrupt the site, accessing data that is not your own, or contacting third parties about an unverified issue.

Gurjas Evidence and Policy Analytics will acknowledge responsible reports as soon as practicable and will coordinate remediation and disclosure according to the issue's severity and evidence. This policy does not promise a bounty, payment, or a fixed resolution time.

For ordinary service, content, accessibility, or privacy enquiries that are not security vulnerabilities, use the public contact route at https://gurjas.org/contact/.
